statusReason: NBA is HISTORICAL_ONLY: freshest real data 2026-06-13, no current output, machinery intact. This selects the single most defensible market FAMILY to REBUILD a re-validated model around when the season returns (~Oct 2026); it does NOT approve modeling or exposure now.
reason: requires OOS validation + founder review — NBA is HISTORICAL_ONLY
evidenceSource: app/public/data/results/settled_leans.jsonl (4,592 settled rows; 16 slate dates 2026-05-15 -> 2026-06-13; 3,635 decisive). Model vs de-vig market probabilities reconstructed per row: marketProb = no-vig(oddsOver, oddsUnder) for the lean side; modelProb = marketProb + edgePct/100; outcome = 1 if result=='win'. Methodology mirrors app/scripts/audit-mlb-modeled-markets.mjs.
crossChecks: The 903 invalid rows are exactly the four unsettleable prop families (3PM 245 + BLK 172 + PRA 267 + STL 219 = 903).

3PM.note: 100% invalid — settlement join never resolved a box-score value

REB.note: The ONLY settleable market above a coin flip (hit 0.5454) AND the closest to the de-vig market baseline (Brier gap +0.0069, near parity). Rebounds are an unambiguous box-score counting stat -> cleanest settlement + lowest join ambiguity. Best FIRST family to recalibrate around.

PTS.note: Largest sample + clean settlement, but the model is decisively WORSE than market (Brier gap +0.0354) and below a coin flip (0.4730). Not a defensible FIRST rebuild target.

AST.note: Worst calibrated of the three settleable markets (Brier gap +0.0401, hit 0.4514); assists carry more scorer-discretion / pace noise. Reject as FIRST.

PRA.note: Composite; 100% invalid in the historical data — cannot be validated until the settlement join is rebuilt.

rationale: Of the seven prop families the pipeline produced, only three (REB, PTS, AST) were ever decisively settled — the other four (3PM, PRA, STL, BLK) are 100% invalid (0 of 903 rows graded), so they cannot be validated at all until the box-score settlement join is rebuilt. Among the three settleable markets, REB is the only one above a coin flip (0.5454 on 1,212 decisive) AND the only one that is essentially at market parity on Brier (+0.0069) rather than decisively worse (PTS +0.0354, AST +0.0401). Rebounds are also the least ambiguous counting stat to settle. REB therefore has the shortest, most credible path from 'not market-proven' to 'beats the de-vig market' after recalibration.
honestCaveat: REB is a CANDIDATE, not an approved model. Even REB does NOT currently beat the de-vig market: its Brier (0.2503) is still worse than the market's (0.2434) and the model is systematically overconfident (avg model prob 0.613 vs 0.545 actual). Selecting REB means 'rebuild and re-validate this family first', not 'this market has an edge'. This mirrors the MLB demoted-markets finding (docs referenced in MEMORY: gtp-modeled-markets-demoted).
rejectedAlternatives: PTS/AST rejected as FIRST: settleable and large-sample but the model is decisively worse than the market and below a coin flip. 3PM/PRA/STL/BLK rejected: 100% invalid historically — unsettleable, so unvalidatable, until the settlement join is fixed.
requiredBaseline: de-vig closing (or pregame-captured) sportsbook probability for REB Over/Under, reconstructable today from oddsOver/oddsUnder on the 21 captured boards.
requiredFeatures: see docs/NBA_FEATURE_AND_TIMING_CONTRACT.md — all pregame, boardGeneratedAt<tipoff, trailing form from strictly-prior games only.
graduationCriteria: On a strictly chronological out-of-sample split (train early slates, test held-out later slates, calibration refit ONLY on train), the recalibrated REB model must beat the de-vig market baseline on BOTH Brier score and log loss, be probability-calibrated, and carry no unresolved leakage — then founder review. Identical bar to the MLB gate.
reactivationDependencies: stats.nba.com timeout / resilient box-score source (see docs/NBA_REACTIVATION_ARCHITECTURE.md)
